bounty_proposal_version_check.name: bounty_proposal_version_check
bounty_proposal_version_check.value: ("bounty_proposal"."version" = 0 AND "bounty_proposal"."versioned_at" IS NULL AND "bounty_proposal"."version_revision" IS NULL) OR ("bounty_proposal"."version" > 0 AND "bounty_proposal"."versioned_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bounty_proposal"."version_revision" > 0)

bounty_proposal_money_check.name: bounty_proposal_money_check
bounty_proposal_money_check.value: ("bounty_proposal"."complexity" = 'unsized' AND "bounty_proposal"."amount_minor" IS NULL AND "bounty_proposal"."currency" IS NULL) OR ("bounty_proposal"."complexity" <> 'unsized' AND "bounty_proposal"."amount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "bounty_proposal"."amount_minor" > 0 AND "bounty_proposal"."amount_minor" <= 9007199254740991 AND "bounty_proposal"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "bounty_proposal"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

bounty_run_scope_check.name: bounty_run_scope_check
bounty_run_scope_check.value: ("bounty_run"."kind" not in ('backlog', 'issue') OR "bounty_run"."board_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("bounty_run"."kind" <> 'bounty' OR "bounty_run"."bounty_id" IS NOT NULL)

bounty_run_source_check.name: bounty_run_source_check
bounty_run_source_check.value: ("bounty_run"."kind" in ('backlog', 'issue', 'bounty') AND "bounty_run"."source_proposal_id" IS NULL AND "bounty_run"."source_revision" IS NULL) OR ("bounty_run"."kind" in ('reprice', 'respec') AND "bounty_run"."source_revision" > 0)

rate_card_amounts_check.name: rate_card_amounts_check
rate_card_amounts_check.value: coalesce("rate_card"."xs_minor", "rate_card"."s_minor") > 0 AND coalesce("rate_card"."xs_minor", "rate_card"."s_minor") <= "rate_card"."s_minor" AND "rate_card"."s_minor" <= "rate_card"."m_minor" AND "rate_card"."m_minor" <= "rate_card"."l_minor" AND "rate_card"."l_minor" <= "rate_card"."xl_minor" AND "rate_card"."xl_minor" <= 9007199254740991

sandbox_version_source_origin_check.name: sandbox_version_source_origin_check
sandbox_version_source_origin_check.value: ("sandbox_version_source"."slice_run_id" is not null and "sandbox_version_source"."source_snapshot_id" is not null and "sandbox_version_source"."manifest_sha256" is not null and "sandbox_version_source"."contract_sha256" is not null and "sandbox_version_source"."starter_run_id" is null) or ("sandbox_version_source"."slice_run_id" is null and "sandbox_version_source"."source_snapshot_id" is null and "sandbox_version_source"."manifest_sha256" is null and "sandbox_version_source"."contract_sha256" is null and "sandbox_version_source"."starter_run_id" is not null)
